product_flow.name: Photographic plates, film, paper, paperboard and textiles, exposed but not developed

required_qualifiers: actual site and reporting period
film manufacturer and exact lot
HP5 PLUS black-and-white silver-gelatin negative system
polyester sheet support and complete retained coatings
nominal 5x4-inch format and measured actual contour
net film mass and independent packaging tare at stated moisture
actual sheet count and lot-specific mass conversion if used
unexposed receipt and upstream whole-film provider boundary
holder identity and emulsion orientation
optical exposure event and actual validated settings
absence of chemical development on reference sheets
dark handling and protected traceable transfer
unique first-release event and cohort Q
raw WIP unused-non-WIP and FG inventories with inherited vectors
black-bag and reusable-box construction and reuse pools
individual cleaning chemical and supplied formulation
native utility geography voltage and supply route
actual asset configuration and measured use allocation
each real waste species receiver and treatment boundary
observed later-service interval H and original Qc
uncertainty missing data and deviations

product_flow.name: 已曝光但尚未显影的照相干版、胶片、相纸、纸板及织物

required_qualifiers: 实际场址及报告期
胶片制造商及准确批次
HP5 PLUS黑白银盐明胶负片体系
聚酯散页片基及全部保留涂层
标称5×4英寸幅面及实测实际轮廓
声明含湿状态下的胶片净质量及独立包装皮重
实际片数及采用时的同批实测质量换算
未曝光收料及整份胶片上游供方边界
片夹身份及乳剂面朝向
光学曝光事件及实际经验证设置
参考片未经过化学显影
全暗操作及可追溯保护交接
唯一首次放行事件及批次Q
原料/在制品/未用非在制品/成品库存及继承向量
黑袋及可复用盒结构与周转池
各清洁化学品及整份供货制剂
原生能源地理/电压及供给路线
实际资产配置及实测使用分配
各实际废物/物种/接收方及处理边界
实际观察的后续服务区间H及原Qc
不确定性/缺失数据及偏差
